legal.privacidad.hero.title: Privacy policy
legal.privacidad.hero.subtitle: How the personal data of people who visit and contact {web} is collected, processed and protected, in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Spain's LOPDGDD.

legal.privacidad.s1.body: Ahmed, trading under the business name {nombre}, operating in {zona}. Contact: {email}.
legal.privacidad.s2.title: 2. What data we process and why
legal.privacidad.s2.body1: Data you provide when contacting us via WhatsApp, phone or email: name, phone number, email address and the content of the message or query you send us (for example, the pricing option you're interested in). We use it solely to respond to your query, prepare the requested quote and manage the business relationship if you go on to hire a service.
legal.privacidad.s2.body2: Browsing data: through Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics 4 we collect aggregated data about how the site is used (pages visited, time spent, device type, approximate origin of the visit) to understand how the site is used and improve it. We do not cross-reference this data with your identity unless you have provided it to us through another channel. More detail in the {cookies_label}.
legal.privacidad.s3.title: 3. Legal basis
legal.privacidad.s3.body: Processing of the data you provide when contacting us is based on your consent, given when you start the conversation, and on carrying out the pre-contractual steps needed to prepare the quote you request. Processing of browsing data for analytics purposes is based on your consent, as described in the {cookies_label}.
legal.privacidad.s4.title: 4. Recipients and data processors
legal.privacidad.s4.intro: We do not sell or transfer your data to third parties for commercial purposes. We do share data with the following providers, acting as data processors, to the extent necessary to provide the service:
legal.privacidad.s4.li1: Meta Platforms Ireland Ltd. (WhatsApp): handles the messages you send us through WhatsApp.
legal.privacidad.s4.li2: Google Ireland Ltd.: provides Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics 4 for site analytics.
legal.privacidad.s4.outro: These providers may transfer data outside the European Economic Area, covered by the safeguards set out in the GDPR (standard contractual clauses or other equivalent mechanisms specific to each provider).
legal.privacidad.s5.title: 5. Retention period
legal.privacidad.s5.body: Data provided to handle a query or quote is kept for as long as the business relationship lasts and, afterward, for the legal limitation periods for liability. Analytics data is kept according to the retention periods configured in Google Analytics 4.
legal.privacidad.s6.title: 6. Your rights
legal.privacidad.s6.body: You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction of processing and portability at any time by writing to {email}. You also have the right to file a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (aepd.es) if you believe the processing of your data does not comply with the regulations.
legal.privacidad.s7.title: 7. Automated decisions
legal.privacidad.s7.body: No automated decisions are made and no profiling with legal effects on users is carried out based on the data collected on this site.
legal.privacidad.s8.title: 8. Security
legal.privacidad.s8.body: We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect personal data against unauthorized access, loss or alteration.
legal.privacidad.s9.title: 9. Changes to this policy
legal.privacidad.s9.body: This policy may be updated to reflect legislative changes or changes to how the site works. The date of the last update always appears at the bottom of this page.

legal.cookies.hero.subtitle: What cookies {web} uses, why, and how you can manage them.
legal.cookies.s1.title: 1. What cookies are
legal.cookies.s1.body: Cookies are small files that a website stores in your browser to remember information about your visit, such as preferences or usage statistics.
legal.cookies.s2.title: 2. Cookies used by this site
legal.cookies.s2.intro: This site does not use its own personalization or advertising cookies. The cookies that are set come from the analytics tool we use:
legal.cookies.s2.li1: Google Analytics 4 (managed through Google Tag Manager, container GTM-5D5WS88L): _ga and _ga_* type cookies, which allow us to measure visits, pages viewed and general browsing behaviour in aggregate, without identifying you personally. These are analytics cookies, not advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.
legal.cookies.s2.outro: If you use the WhatsApp links or buttons on this site, you are redirected to the app or to WhatsApp Web, outside this site. That platform may set its own cookies, independent of us and governed by Meta/WhatsApp's own privacy and cookie policy.
legal.cookies.s3.title: 3. We don't run advertising or retargeting
legal.cookies.s3.body: We do not use advertising cookies, do not share your browsing activity with advertising networks, and do not run retargeting campaigns based on your visit to this site.
legal.cookies.s4.title: 4. How to manage or delete cookies
legal.cookies.s4.body: You can change your decision about analytics cookies at any time using the button below, or allow, block or delete the cookies stored on your device from your browser settings. Blocking analytics cookies does not affect your ability to browse the site or contact us; we will simply stop receiving aggregated data about your visit.
legal.cookies.s5.title: 5. Questions
legal.cookies.s5.body: If you have any questions about this policy, write to us at {email}.

profesionales.hero.image_alt: Renovation under way with electrical, plasterboard and painting work
profesionales.hero.body: Work with AHOMED if you are a renovator, builder, interior designer or property manager. Electrical work, painting, plasterboard, blinds, cameras, gardening and final cleaning, with a single point of contact and a fixed price.
profesionales.why.title: I don't want to take your client. I want to take work off your plate.
profesionales.why.body: A job drags on when three or four different trades have to be coordinated. AHOMED covers the simple trades — electrical work, painting, plasterboard and final cleaning — with a single point of contact and clear dates.
profesionales.modelos.title: Three ways to collaborate
profesionales.modelos.body: It's not all or nothing. Choose the model that best fits your business — or combine them.
profesionales.modelos.item1.title: 1. Commission per referred client
profesionales.modelos.item1.body: You introduce us to a client and, if the project goes ahead, you receive a commission on our margin or a fixed amount per closed project. The simplest way to start.
profesionales.aporta.title: What AHOMED covers on your project
profesionales.aporta.body: Seven services that are almost always needed in a renovation or a home about to be handed over. One point of contact for all of them.
profesionales.piloto.title: First trial job, no commitment
profesionales.piloto.body: The easiest way to start collaborating, before discussing any formal agreement.
profesionales.piloto.item1.title: 1. You introduce us to a client
profesionales.piloto.item1.body: You spot the opportunity in a job you already have underway.
profesionales.piloto.item4.title: 4. If it goes well, we make it ongoing
profesionales.piloto.item4.body: We turn the first job into a stable collaboration, with the model that fits best.
profesionales.final.title: Shall we talk about collaborating?
profesionales.final.body: Tell us what kind of projects you do and which trades are hardest for you to cover. We will prepare a tailored collaboration proposal — no obligation.

servicios.final_cta.title: Can't find the service you need?
servicios.final_cta.body: If what you need is not listed here, message me and we will talk it through: tell me what it is and I will say whether I can help. If you are working on a renovation or construction project, see AHOMED for Professionals.

faq.q1.a: Free first technical visit, at your home or business. From it comes a fixed quote with three options — Basic, Standard and Complete — so you choose, with no obligation and no small print.
faq.q2.q: What is the difference between the Basic, Standard and Complete options?
faq.q2.a: Basic is what is needed to solve it properly, at the best price. Standard, the one most people choose, adds better materials and a more complete finish. Complete also includes the extras that make the difference. You always see the breakdown of each one before deciding.
faq.q3.a: No. You pay for the job once. Security cameras record on your own equipment, with no fee or lock-in. The only recurring service is monthly garden maintenance, which is optional and also has no lock-in.
faq.q5.q: How long does a job take?
faq.q5.a: It depends on the service: from a quick job of a couple of hours (a few sockets, a WiFi camera) to several days for painting a whole flat or a large construction clean-up. The exact time is agreed at the technical visit.
faq.q6.q: What guarantee do the jobs have?
faq.q6.a: All AHOMED jobs come with a guarantee and are carried out with top-brand materials.
faq.q7.q: Can I order several jobs at once?
faq.q7.a: Yes, and it usually works out better: for example, plasterboard + electrical work + painting + final cleaning in a renovation. With a single contact the trades are coordinated and waiting between them is avoided.
faq.q8.q: Do I supply the materials or do you?
faq.q8.a: Usually we do, and you see it itemised in the quote. If you prefer to buy something yourself — for example the spotlights, a blind motor or the paint — we deduct it and only take care of installing it.
faq.q9.q: Do you also work with shops, communities or warehouses, or only homes?
faq.q9.a: With all kinds of spaces: flats, houses, shops, offices and communal areas. The quote is adjusted to the size and type of job after the visit.
faq.q10.q: How do I request a quote?
faq.q10.a: Via WhatsApp — it's the fastest and most direct way. The first technical visit is free with no obligation.
faq.q11.q: How are the cameras different from an alarm with a monthly fee?
faq.q11.a: There is no fee. An alarm with a monitoring centre usually costs between €20 and €50 a month, almost always with a lock-in of up to 24 months — in two years you can end up paying over €1,000 and keeping nothing if you leave. With AHOMED cameras you pay for the installation once, with no lock-in, and the equipment is yours. One caveat: it is not an alarm monitoring centre — nobody watches the footage for you; you watch it from your phone or review it whenever you need.
